question_1.text: What is the safest way to log in after receiving a gaming account alert?
choices: A. Click the link in the message
C. Go directly to the game’s official website or app
D. Ask the sender whether the link is real
A. It makes games run more slowly
B. A leaked password can be tried on your other accounts
C. It prevents you from earning rewards

question_3.text: Which situation is most likely a scam?
choices: A. A game installs an official update
B. A friend invites you to a normal match
C. A website promises free V-Bucks if you log in
D. A platform asks you to enable 2FA in its settings

question_4.text: What should you do if an online player pressures you for personal information or pictures?
choices: B. Stop communicating and tell a trusted adult
C. Move the conversation to another app
D. Ask them for their information first
